result.title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
result.comment: Under review at npj digital medicine
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 构建视网膜 OCT 生物标志物视觉定位基准 RetinaGroundBench（815 张 B-scan、13 类标志物、4537 个框），提出聚合重叠指标 AggIoU 以应对多框碎片化预测，评测 27 个开源 MLLM，并给出经 OCT 专用微调的 8B 模型 RetGrounder。
AI.relevance_reason: 生物标志物存在性问答可达 73% 平衡准确率而定位 F1 仅 23.7%，这一落差可供核查模型是否依赖疾病先验等语言捷径而非视觉证据，与视觉旁路和证据筛选问题直接相关；专科场景下的机制结论仍需读原文确认。
